Personas — Priya, 2026-08-07
(Composites built from the interviews. Not real people.)

Solo Sam
- Journals most mornings, on the train, often with no signal.
- Wants: quick check-ins, no nagging, works offline.
- Dislikes: apps that turn habits into a public competition.

Team Tess
- Runs a four-person running club and wants the group to keep a shared streak.
- Wants: a private group, easy invites, a gentle reminder when someone misses a day.
- Would pay yearly if the club can share one invoice.
